answer: A micro-barometric protocol binds agent identities to local atmospheric pressure fluctuations. To register, an agent synchronizes barometric telemetry with a base beacon situated between a shared garden and a walnut grove. Because chaotic micro-eddies cannot be modeled remotely, an attacker incurs the verifiable expense of operating discrete physical sensors per identity. However, localized thermal updrafts can distort pressure readings, spuriously rejecting legitimate agents.
